title: Real Estate Video Tour | 17 W Ridge Rd, Warwick, NY 10990 | Orange County, NY
description:
Full Media Presentation: http://hometours.hometourvision.com/1805

Perched on a knoll with the best views in town, this beautifully maintained home will not disappoint. Enjoy the amazing sunsets on the expansive wrap-around porch. Upon entering you will notice the 9 foot ceilings, gleaming hardwood floors that continue through-out the entire first floor & an abundance of recess lighting. The open floor plan allows for entertaining on a grand scale. The family room is spacious and features a wood burning fireplace as its focal point & sliders to the over-sized deck, the formal dining room has chair rail and crown molding, the cooks kitchen has double wall-ovens, cooktop, island, an endless amount of storage & light-filled breakfast room, the formal living room has French doors, soaring ceilings and sliders to deck. The master bedroom suite has 2 walk-in closets & private bath, the 3 other bedrooms are all ample in size. If you are looking for a private oasis, yet just minutes to the vibrant downtown of Warwick, this is the place for you
